verdict.rationale: Resend documents a full SMTP relay at smtp.resend.com with multiple ports and clear credential setup (username 'resend', password = API key), explicitly framed as an alternative integration path for non-API use cases (resend-docs-4, resend-docs-23, resend-docs-32). API keys are generated in the dashboard/API and can be scoped, which serve as the SMTP password. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation of SMTP usage specifically (all community evidence discusses API/dashboard, not SMTP) and no explicit mention of legacy-app framework compatibility testing.
